provenance.scope: Static native branches; no game execution or runtime XLua verification.

selection.excluded: Enemy base and XLua base proxies

result.limits: Only decoded destination-memory operands at exact listed displacements in declared descendant methods; aliases through computed addresses, overlapping wider stores, other base offsets, indirect and hotfix operations are not exhaustively excluded. Nearest native boundaries include padding/data; fullyDecoded flags retained.
